parse_version(latest);\n109\t    let current_parts = parse_version(current);\n110\t\n111\t    for (l, c) in latest_parts.iter().zip(current_parts.iter()) {\n112\t        if l > c {\n113\t            return true;\n114\t        }\n115\t        if l < c {\n116\t            return false;\n117\t        }\n118\t    }\n119\t\n120\t    latest_parts.len() > current_parts.len()\n121\t}\n122\t\n123\t/// Get the platform-specific suffix for release asset names (e.g. \"x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu\").\n124\tfn get_platform_suffix() -> Result<&'static str> {\n125\t    let os = env::consts::OS;\n126\t    let arch = env::consts::ARCH;\n127\t\n128\t    let suffix = match (os, arch) {\n129\t        (\"linux\", \"x86_64\") => \"x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu\",\n130\t        (\"linux\", \"aarch64\") => \"aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu\",\n131\t        (\"macos\", \"x86_64\") => \"x86_64-apple-darwin\",\n132\t        (\"macos\", \"aarch64\") => \"aarch64-apple-darwin\",\n133\t        _ => bail!(\"unsupported platform: {os} {arch}\"),\n134\t    };\n135\t\n136\t    Ok(suffix)\n137\t}\n138\t\n139\t/// Get the asset name for the current platform.\n140\tfn get_asset_name() -> Result<String> {\n141\t    Ok(format!(\"needle-{}\", get_platform_suffix()?))\n142\t}\n143\t\n144\t/// Transform binaries shipped alongside needle.\n145\tconst TRANSFORM_BINARIES: &[&str] = &[\"needle-transform-claude\", \"needle-transform-codex\"];\n146\t\n147\t/// Download and install transform binaries next to the needle binary.\n148\t///\n149\t/// Missing assets are skipped with a warning — the main upgrade is not aborted.\n150\t/// After upgrade, `needle doctor` will report any transform that is not on PATH.\n151\tfn install_transform_binaries(install_dir: &Path, platform_suffix: &str) {\n152\t    for transform in TRANSFORM_BINARIES {\n153\t        let asset_name = format!(\"{transform}-{platform_suffix}\");\n154\t        let url = asset_download_url(&asset_name);\n155\t        let dest = install_dir.join(transform);\n156\t\n157\t        println!(\"Installing {transform}...\");\n158\t\n159\t        let response = match ureq::agent()\n160\t            .get(&url)\n161\t            .set(\"User-Agent\", &format!(\"needle/{CURRENT_VERSION}\"))\n162\t            .call()\n163\t        {\n164\t            Ok(r) if r.status() < 400 => r,\n165\t            Ok(r) => {\n166\t                println!(\n167\t                    \"  Warning: {transform} not in release (HTTP {}), skipping.\",\n168\t                    r.status()\n169\t                );\n170\t                continue;\n171\t            }\n172\t            Err(e) => {\n173\t                println!(\"  Warning: failed to download {transform}: {e}. Skipping.\");\n174\t                continue;\n175\t            }\n176\t        };\n177\t\n178\t        let mut content = Vec::new();\n179\t        if let Err(e) = response.into_reader().read_to_end(&mut content) {\n180\t            println!(\"  Warning: failed to read {transform}: {e}. Skipping.\");\n181\t            continue;\n182\t        }\n183\t\n184\t        let temp_path = dest.with_extension(\"tmp\");\n185\t        if let Err(e) = fs::write(&temp_path, &content) {\n186\t            println!(\n187\t                \"  Warning: failed to write {transform} to {}: {e}. Skipping.\",\n188\t                temp_path.display()\n189\t            );\n190\t            continue;\n191\t        }\n192\t\n193\t        #[cfg(unix)]\n194\t        {\n195\t            use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;\n196\t            if let Err(e) = fs::set_permissions(&temp_path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)) {\n197\t                println!(\"  Warning: failed to chmod {transform}: {e}. Skipping.\");\n198\t                let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);\n199\t                continue;\n200\t            }\n201\t        }\n202\t\n203\t        if let Err(e) = fs::rename(&temp_path, &dest) {\n204\t            println!(\"  Warning: failed to install {transform}: {e}. Skipping.\");\n205\t            let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path);\n206\t            continue;\n207\t        }\n208\t\n209\t        println!(\"  {transform} installed to {}.\", dest.display());\n210\t    }\n211\t}\n212\t\n213\t/// Download and install the latest version of needle.\n214\t///\n215\t/// Returns the path to the new binary.\n216\tpub fn perform_upgrade() -> Result<PathBuf> {\n217\t    let check = check_for_update()?;\n218\t\n219\t    if !check.update_available {\n220\t        println!(\"Already up to date (version {})\", check.current_version);\n221\t        return get_current_binary_path();\n222\t    }\n223\t\n224\t    println!(\n225\t        \"Upgrading from {} to {}...\",\n226\t        check.current_version, check.latest_version\n227\t    );\n228\t\n229\t    let asset_name = get_asset_name()?;\n230\t    let download_url = asset_download_url(&asset_name);\n231\t\n232\t    println!(\"Downloading from {download_url}...\");\n233\t\n234\t .call()\n239\t        .context(\"failed to download new binary\")?;\n240\t\n241\t    if response.status() >= 400 {\n242\t        bail!(\"download failed with status {}\", response.status());\n243\t .context(\"failed to read downloaded content\")?;\n251\t\n252\t    // Write the new binary to :testing channel for canary validation.\n253\t    let home = needle_home();\n254\t    let bin_dir = home.join(\"bin\");\n255\t    fs::create_dir_all(&bin_dir).context(\"failed to create bin directory\")?;\n256\t    let testing_binary = bin_dir.join(\"needle-testing\");\n257\t\n258\t    // Write the new binary to :testing.\n259\t    let mut cursor = Cursor::new(&content);\n260\t    {\n261\t        let mut file =\n262\t            fs::File::create(&testing_binary).context(\"failed to create testing binary file\")?;\n263\t        io::copy(&mut cursor, &mut file).context(\"failed to write testing binary\")?;\n264\t    }\n265\t\n266\t    // Make it executable.\n267\t    #[cfg(unix)]\n268\t    {\n269\t        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;\n270\t        fs::set_permissions(&testing_binary, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755))\n271\t            .context(\"failed to set executable permissions on testing binary\")?;\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\t    println!(\n275\t        \"Downloaded version {} to {}\",\n276\t        check.latest_version,\n277\t        testing_binary.display()\n278\t    );\n279\t\n280\t    // Run canary validation if canary workspace exists.\n281\t    let canary_workspace = home.join(\"canary\");\n282\t    if canary_workspace.exists() {\n283\t        println!(\"Running canary validation...\");\n284\t\n285\t        use crate::canary::CanaryRunner;\n286\t\n287\t        let runner = CanaryRunner::new(\n288\t            home.clone(),\n289\t            canary_workspace,\n290\t            300, // 5 minute test timeout\n291\t        );\n292\t\n293\t        let report = runner.run().context(\"canary validation failed\")?;\n294\t\n295\t        if !report.suite_passed {\n296\t            // Canary failed - reject the testing binary\n297\t            runner\n298\t                .reject()\n299\t                .context(\"failed to reject testing binary after canary failure\")?;\n300\t\n301\t            anyhow::bail!(\n302\t                \"canary validation failed: {}/{} tests passed. \\\n303\t                 The testing binary has been rejected. \\\n304\t                 Run 'needle canary --status' for details.\",\n305\t                report.passed,\n306\t                report.total_tests\n307\t            );\n308\t        }\n309\t\n310\t        println!(\n311\t            \"Canary validation passed: {}/{} tests passed.\",\n312\t            report.passed, report.total_tests\n313\t        );\n314\t\n315\t        // Promote :testing to :stable\n316\t        runner\n317\t            .promote()\n318\t            .context(\"failed to promote testing binary to stable\")?;\n319\t Installing without validation.\",\n323\t            canary_workspace.display()\n324\t        );\n325\t        println!(\"WARNING: Skipping canary validation is not recommended for production upgrades.\");\n326\t        println!(\n327\t            \"         Set up a canary workspace at {} to enable validation.\",\n328\t            canary_workspace.display()\n329\t        );\n330\t\n331\t        // Create a minimal canary runner for promotion only (no tests run)\n332\t        use crate::canary::CanaryRunner;\n333\t        let runner = CanaryRunner::new(home.clone(), canary_workspace, 300);\n334\t\n335\t        // Promote without canary validation (fallback behavior)\n336\t        runner\n337\t            .promote()\n338\t            .context(\"failed to promote testing binary to stable\")?;\n339\t        println!(\"Promoted to :stable (without canary validation)\");\n340\t    }\n341\t\n342\t    println!(\"Successfully upgraded to version {}!\", check.latest_version);\n343\t\n344\t    // Install companion transform binaries to the same directory as needle.\n345\t    let stable_path = bin_dir.join(\"needle-stable\");\n346\t    let install_dir ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n375\t\n376\t/// Compute the SHA-256 hash of a file, returned as a hex string.\n377\tpub fn file_hash(path: &Path) -> Result<String> {\n378\t    let content = fs::read(path)\n379\t        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read file for hashing: {}\", path.display()))?;\n380\t    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n381\t    hasher.update(&content);\n382\t    let result = hasher.finalize();\n383\t    Ok(hex::encode(result))\n384\t}\n385\t\n386\t/// Result of checking for a new :stable binary.\n387\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\n388\tpub enum HotReloadCheck {\n389\t    /// No change detected — current binary matches :stable.\n390\t    NoChange,\n391\t    /// New :stable binary detected with different hash.\n392\t    NewBinaryDetected {\n393\t        /// Hash of the currently running binary.\n394\t        old_hash: String,\n395\t        /// Hash of the new :stable binary.\n396\t        new_hash: String,\n397\t        /// Path to the new :stable binary.\n398\t        stable_path: PathBuf,\n399\t    },\n400\t    /// Current binary has been deleted/unlinked (e.g., mv-replaced while running).\n401\t    /// This is an unconditional signal to re-exec into :stable immediately.\n402\t    CurrentBinaryDeleted {\n403\t        /// Hash of the :stable binary to re-exec into.\n404\t        stable_hash: String,\n405\t        /// Path to the new :stable binary.\n406\t        stable_path: PathBuf,\n407\t    },\n408\t    /// Hot-reload is disabled or :stable binary not found.\n409\t    Skipped { reason: String },\n410\t}\n411\t\n412\t/// Check whether the `:stable` binary differs from the currently running binary.\n413\t///\n414\t/// This is called between LOGGING and SELECTING in the worker loop.\n415\tpub fn check_hot_reload(needle_home: &Path) -> Result<HotReloadCheck> {\n416\t    let stable_path = needle_home.join(\"bin/needle-stable\");\n417\t\n418\t    if !stable_path.exists() {\n419\t        return Ok(HotReloadCheck::Skipped {\n420\t            reason: \"no :stable binary found\".to_string(),\n421\t        });\n422\t    }\n423\t\n424\t    let file_hash(&stable_path)?;\n437\t        tracing::warn!(\n438\t            current_path = %current_path.display(),\n439\t            \"current binary has been deleted/unlinked — forcing hot-reload into :stable\"\n440\t        );\n441\t        return Ok(HotReloadCheck::CurrentBinaryDeleted {\n442\t            stable_hash,\n443\t            stable_path,\n444\t        });\n445\t    }\n446\t\n447\t the current process.\n464\t/// On failure, it returns an error so the worker can continue on the current binary.\n465\t#[cfg(unix)]\n466\tpub fn re_exec_stable(\n467\t    stable_path: &Path,\n468\t    worker_name: &str,\n469\t    workspace: Option<&Path>,\n470\t    agent: Option<&str>,\n471\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n472\t) -> Result<()> {\n473\t    use std::os::unix::process::CommandExt;\n474\t\n475\t    let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(stable_path);\n476\t    cmd.arg(\"run\").arg(\"--resume\");\n477\t }\n489\t\n490\t    // exec() replaces the current process — does not return on success.\n491\t    let err = cmd.exec();\n492\t    Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"re-exec failed: {}\", err))\n493\t}\n494\t\n495\t#[cfg(not(unix))]\n496\tpub fn re_exec_stable(\n497\t    _stable_path: &Path,\n498\t    _worker_name: &str,\n499\t    _workspace: Option<&Path>,\n500\t    _agent:
